$comment: Every control the docs/ENCRYPTION_AT_REST.md baseline requires must be
declared here. An undeclared control reads as disabled, which is why the
validator treats a missing field as a failure rather than skipping it.
kek_protection: KMS key with HSM-backed storage, key policy denies root
nonce_strategy: 96-bit random per encryption, never reused with the same DEK
notes: AAD binds a ciphertext to its tenant and record type, so a row copied into
another tenant's table fails to decrypt rather than silently decrypting.
Logs, analytics events and error reports carry no PII; see
